headline: Premier League + International Break = Injuries
body: A 3-week international break? Don't worry: a 4-week international break is in the cards, as early as next season I believe. It's getting to the point where one can be forgiven for wondering if there even is a Premier League. I really wish the EPL would grow some sack and started giving FIFA a bit of blowback for a change, instead of it constantly being the other way around. And don't get me started on injuries... Not just for the Arse, but for everyone. I mean, look at Sunderland. Bournemouth. It's absurd. If I were a team owner, I would be apoplectic over all these injuries. And for what? Unnecessary bogus games in an unnecessarily bogus cup competition? Dear lord.   submitted by   /u/Inevitable_Flan_2912 [link]   [comments]
